description: Next.js App Router + ad-frame JSON family (currently: nicomanga). Pages are shells carrying a one-time payloadKey (l_ list/search/genre, m_ detail, c_ reader); real data comes from GET {origin}/ad-frame/data?k={key} and decodes with the CJK-XOR scheme. The nhasixapp kuron_generic adapter reads secondaryFetch ONLY at three sites (generic_scraper_adapter.dart): urlPatterns.<name>.list.secondaryFetch (search/genreSearch/tagSearch inherit home's list block via mergeLists shallow spread, so they ride along), selectors.detail.secondaryFetch, selectors.reader.secondaryFetch. Scraper-level or listKey/detailKey/readerKey/surfaces shapes are NOT read by the adapter and must not appear in final configs (build_from_presets.py --check fails on them). Lists decode the obfuscated `items` string field in place (payloadPath AND itemsPath are both 'items' — with payloadPath '' the items string would never decode); detail/reader decode payloadPath 'chaotic_payload' (detail needs no itemFields: _extractChaoticDetailFields defaults match manga/chapters_list; reader uses imagesPath 'images'). tagSearch routes need pattern-level tagTransform 'base64' so tag names encode to the site's /g/{base64}.html form.
